name: Błażej Dubiel
title: Software Engineer
summary: Software engineer with 4+ years of experience building scalable applications across diverse domains. Enthusiastic about turning unknowns into efficient solutions. Currently pursuing a career in AI through contributing to impactful projects in the field. I spend my free time on analog photography and music.

bullets: Successfully designed and developed the control software for a prototype clarifier machine used in a chemical laboratory at a beet sugar factory to maintain chemical solutions at specific concentrations and temperatures. Built both the front-end and back-end for a Raspberry Pi.
Developing and and maintaining track and trace software infrastructure to ensure compliance and operational efficiency within EU tobacco directive on tracebility of tobacco products.
That includes implementation of data applications ensuring data aggregation and processing, control logic of industrials machines, HMI design and vision systems configuration.
Led several successful projects, implementing software architecture enhancements and enabling secure, safety-compliant AI deployment across the company.
Responsible for Claude Code adaptation within the software team, including research, infrastructure set up, skills and routines design.
Working closely with clients remotely during development and service, as well as on-site during the commissioning of new machines
Daily collaboration with cross-functional teams, including engineers from different departments and product managers.
Conducted research as part of a project entitled “Autonomous Detection and Classification of Bituminous Joints in Highway Pavement Using Two-Staged and Residual-Based Convolutional Autoencoder.

Extracted and preprocessed intensity-based data from a laser-triangulation system and developed an end-to-end unsupervised pipeline for bituminous joint detection, addressing label sparsity, anomaly detection, feature space inhomogeneity, and normalization challenges.
Thesis outcomes received high acclaim, earning a grade of 7.5 from academia and recognition from the host company, where the proposed approach established a benchmark for future projects.
